signal: Selerix acquired The Benefits eXpert in February 2025 and Steele Benefits in September 2025 to build an all-in-one benefits administration platform now supporting 26,000+ employers and 14M+ employees.

email.body1:
Michelle, saw Selerix acquire TBX and Steele Benefits to build out an all-in-one benefits platform across 26,000+ employers.

Folding in acquisitions like that usually means more brokers and employers in play than the team can personally cover, and good accounts go quiet before a rep follows up. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Selerix off your acquisition and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Michelle, quick follow-up for Selerix.

With two acquisitions absorbed, the cross-sell and net-new surface is large, but most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number. The gap shows up late, and then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Selerix needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Michelle, last bit of proof for Selerix.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Selerix's reply rate likely compares to other HR-tech companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Michelle, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating two acquisitions is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an HR-tech motion? I will tailor it to Selerix either way.
